roles.functionStatement: Turn spatial and remotely sensed data into validated map and model products whose accuracy and limits are stated for the decision they serve.

majorDuties.duty: Analyze remotely sensed data to map and monitor environmental conditions

tasks.statement: Preprocess imagery for analysis by correcting geometry, radiometry and cloud or shadow contamination, documenting each step and its parameters.
Interpret satellite and aerial imagery to detect changes in vegetation, soil or water condition across a management area between two dates.
Classify preprocessed multispectral imagery into land-cover types using training data whose collection method and date are documented.
Assess the accuracy of a remotely sensed map against independent field reference data, reporting error by class and condition.
Check whether a map product shares training data with the reference used to validate it, choosing an independent reference when it does.

majorDuties.duty: Conduct spatial analysis and modelling of environmental data

tasks.statement: Run spatial queries and overlays for an environmental assessment, checking that all layers share a coordinate reference system and compatible scales.
Analyze terrain, habitat connectivity or resource distribution for a planning question, stating the data, projection and accuracy limits that bound the answer.
Build a predictive spatial model for a conservation planning question, documenting its inputs, assumptions and validation against independent locations.
Maintain spatial layers of land use, vegetation and infrastructure with topology rules, attribute standards and update dates recorded.

majorDuties.duty: Design maps and visualizations that communicate environmental data and uncertainty

tasks.statement: Design a map for a stated audience and decision, choosing scale, extent, symbology and colour that the audience reads correctly.
Depict the uncertainty of a mapped or charted estimate with an encoding that intended users read correctly in a comprehension check.
Produce maps for reports, briefings and field crews at the scale, extent and legibility each use requires.

majorDuties.duty: Build and validate automated detection and classification models for environmental observations

tasks.statement: Validate a detection model against field ground-truth data, reporting error by habitat, season and image condition.

majorDuties.duty: Conduct reproducible, auditable environmental analysis, including AI-assisted code

tasks.statement: Record the software environment, package versions and inputs of an analysis so that it can be re-run years later.
Write a script that automates a repetitive data-processing step, with tests that confirm it reproduces the manual result on sample data.
Review AI-generated analysis code line by line against the analysis plan, testing it on cases with known answers before use.

majorDuties.duty: Quantify and communicate uncertainty for environmental decisions

tasks.statement: Report results with the uncertainty the method provides, such as intervals or confidence classes, keeping it in every summary of the result.

majorDuties.duty: Steward and publish environmental data for reuse

tasks.statement: Document a dataset's sources, methods, formats and fitness for use in a metadata record that meets the applicable standard.

majorDuties.duty: Protect sensitive ecological, cultural and personal information in data products

tasks.statement: Generalize sensitive fields in the distributed copy of a dataset, or withhold them, while leaving the stored record unaltered and explaining each withheld field.

majorDuties.duty: Operate and supervise uncrewed and automated field systems

tasks.statement: Verify the positional accuracy of uncrewed-aircraft survey products against independently surveyed check points before release to users

majorDuties.duty: Validate AI-generated work products before professional use

tasks.statement: Validate a large batch of AI detections or comment codes by drawing a defined sample, reviewing it and estimating the batch error rate.

roles.functionStatement: Establish whether remote, modelled and automated products can be relied on, by collecting and stewarding independent field reference evidence.

majorDuties.duty: Ground-truth remote-sensed, modelled and AI-generated outputs in the field

tasks.statement: Design a field validation sample with an analyst, setting strata, sample size and access limits for a remote-sensed or AI product
Record reference observations at pre-selected validation points with the reference protocol, without access to the product's predicted value
Code the likely field cause of each mismatch between a remote product and field observation, such as timing, mixed pixels, hidden understory or location error
Report field-coded mismatches to the product's analyst or provider with photos and locations so that the model can be corrected

majorDuties.duty: Design and steward field reference data for Earth-observation and AI models

tasks.statement: Collect labelled field samples to the reference protocol, recording the metadata that models and validators need to reuse them
Relabel reference records when a field revisit shows land change or an original labelling error, versioning the dataset and recording the reason
Maintain a reference dataset's versions, provenance and access conditions so that each label can be traced to its field observation
Generalize the locations of sensitive species and sites in a reference dataset before sharing, following the dataset's access conditions

majorDuties.duty: Calibrate field observers and run field measurement quality assurance

tasks.statement: Re-measure a random sample of crew plots blind to the original data, recording differences for comparison against measurement-quality tolerances
Compute agreement between observers or assessors against stated tolerances, identifying the measurements and observers that fall outside them

majorDuties.duty: Adjudicate automated species detections using field-formed identification expertise

tasks.statement: Review classifier-labelled camera, acoustic or genetic detections in a program queue, accepting, rejecting or escalating each against the recording
Estimate false-positive and false-negative rates of an automated detector on a verified local validation set, reporting rates by species
Reject automated detections that are implausible for the place, season or habitat, stating the ecological reason for each rejection

majorDuties.duty: Validate AI-generated work products before professional use

tasks.statement: Validate a large batch of AI detections or comment codes by drawing a defined sample, reviewing it and estimating the batch error rate.

majorDuties.duty: Build task-specific evaluation sets and benchmark AI tools before adoption

tasks.statement: Label items for a reference set following written guidelines without seeing tool outputs, flagging ambiguous items for adjudication.

majorDuties.duty: Identify organisms from field characters, specimens, images and recordings

tasks.statement: Verify species records submitted by crews or volunteers against attached photos, recordings or vouchers before they enter the program database

majorDuties.duty: Sample and assess vegetation using standardized field protocols

tasks.statement: Establish vegetation monitoring plots to protocol and record species composition, cover and density within the program's measurement-quality objectives
Compare remote-sensed vegetation cover estimates with plot data across strata, coding the field cause of each disagreement for the analyst
